name: Rentabilité par projet par centre de coût
report_name: Rentabilité par projet par centre de coût
query:
SELECT
	gle.project AS project,
	IFNULL(proj.project_name, gle.project) AS project_name,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Clan - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS clan,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Colonie - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS colonie,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Groupe - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS groupe,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Louvette - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS louvette,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Meute - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS meute,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Troupe - 188' AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS troupe,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (IFNULL(gle.cost_center, '') = '' OR gle.cost_center NOT IN ('Clan - 188', 'Colonie - 188', 'Groupe - 188', 'Louvette - 188', 'Meute - 188', 'Troupe - 188')) AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS autres,
	ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total
FROM
	`tabGL Entry` gle
	INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = gle.account
	INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year` fy ON fy.name = %(fiscal_year)s
	LEFT JOIN `tabProject` proj ON proj.name = gle.project
WHERE
	gle.company = %(company)s
	AND gle.is_cancelled = 0
	AND gle.posting_date BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date
	AND IFNULL(gle.project, '') != ''
GROUP BY
	gle.project,
	proj.project_name
HAVING
	ABS(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense') THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END), 2)) > 0.005
ORDER BY
	proj.project_name
